item.title: Self-Hosted Kubernetes Topology-Aware Scheduling: Topology Manager, NUMA & Spread Constraints (2026)
item.description: When running performance-sensitive workloads on Kubernetes — databases, machine learning inference, network functions, or high-throughput APIs — pod placement matters enormously. A pod scheduled on a node with the wrong CPU topology, NUMA configuration, or zone distribution can experience 2-10x performance degradation compared to an optimally placed pod.
